items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I was teaching Christian at the same time... I showed him, and he took the guitar. And he sat down and he did it, and in a few minutes, he had it.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was with him with he was teaching Charlie, Charlie Parker Casey, show him how to hold it. Put his hand here and there and blow this, and Charles wasn't reading. And I was teaching Christian at the same time, so that's why -- we made a script like that in the movie, he and I sat down and talked, and he told me, he say, you remember such-and-such a place when Charlie came by, he took the guitar off the wall and he played the piano?

And we both -- Charlie's tone was so bad, that Buster said -- discussed him, said, I don't want to play sax no more. And so Charlie was trying to play like Buster, all the time, but he didn't get what Buster played, so he come out with something of his own which made history for him. So that's the way that happened.
